task.description: WF-03 Step 4b, hard gate on TEST-DESIGNER's coverage for ISS-0896. Read web/tests/unit/e2e-helpers/get-master-admin-token.test.ts and web/tests/e2e/helpers.ts directly. Per docs/agents/workflows/WF-03_issue_resolving.md's mutation-testing rule: 'TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR must independently APPLY at least one of the reported mutants and run it -- accepting the reported pass counts is copying a claim, not validating one.' TEST-DESIGNER reported Mutant A (hardcode username/password literals, bypassing resolveCredential) breaks TC-2, and Mutant B (remove the throw-on-non-ok check) breaks TC-3. Apply at least one of these two yourself (use a throwaway git worktree, or apply in place and revert-and-verify per that same section's two licensed techniques), run the test file, and confirm the exact reported test(s) fail and no others. FAIL immediately on any check failure -- no partial credit.
acceptance_criteria: a real, runnable vitest unit test exists for getMasterAdminToken covering the 4 behaviors listed above
at least 2 targeted mutants were applied and each one's specific test failure(s) recorded
every mutation was reverted and the revert verified (git status --porcelain web/ empty, suite re-runs green) before this handoff completes
the thrown-error-on-failure path is confirmed not to leak the attempted credential value in its message

result.summary: Baseline: `npx vitest run tests/unit/e2e-helpers/get-master-admin-token.test.ts` — 4/4 pass. Independently applied both reported mutants in place (not just read TEST-DESIGNER's counts): Mutant A (web/tests/e2e/helpers.ts getMasterAdminToken — replaced resolveCredential('KC_ADMIN_USER','admin')/resolveCredential('KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD','admin') with hardcoded literals 'admin'/'admin') -> re-run showed exactly 1 failure, TC-2 ('expected admin to be real-master-admin'), TC-1/TC-3/TC-4 still passed, matching TEST-DESIGNER's report. Reverted (`git checkout -- web/tests/e2e/helpers.ts`), confirmed `git status --porcelain web/` empty and suite green (4/4) before proceeding. Mutant B (removed the `if (!response.ok())` throw block) -> re-run showed exactly 1 failure, TC-3, matching the reported target; failure mode was a downstream TypeError ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading access_token)') rather than the intended 401 message, which still correctly fails TC-3's `toContain('401')` assertion and confirms the removed guard is load-bearing on that path; TC-1/TC-2/TC-4 still passed. Reverted, re-confirmed `git status --porcelain web/` empty and suite green (4/4). Additional independent checks, all pass: fixtures — fakeRequest() builds a fresh mocked APIRequestContext per call, no shared/module-level state across tests except process.env[KC_ADMIN_USER/PASSWORD] which beforeEach deletes and afterEach restores to the pre-suite original, so tests are order-independent and self-sufficient (each does its own dynamic import and setup, no reliance on another test having run); no hardcoded secrets in the test file — 'admin'/'admin' mirrors the already-documented local-dev fallback in production code, and TC-2/TC-3 use synthetic non-secret marker strings ('real-master-admin', 'leaky-user-marker', etc.); the thrown-error path (helpers.ts line 96, `Keycloak master token request failed: ${response.status()} ${body}`) never interpolates username/password at all, and TC-3 asserts the message excludes the marker values, confirming no credential leak. All 4 acceptance criteria met.
